name: Instant Combat
rules: Stay together: rounds grow harder, and monsters chase the closest adventurer at double speed with 25% faster attacks.
Survive all three groups in a round to get your personal ground pickup. Collect it within 20 s (30 s after the boss).
At 70% and 35% boss HP, stand in each blue rift for 3 s to seal it. Progress stays; the second phase opens an extra rift.
Monsters drop no loot or XP. Rewards come from the round pickups and the boss clear.
Missed events can't be joined after they begin.
